The infrastructure problem you're facing is not a limitation of your creativity or business acumen, but rather a consequence of the restrictive policies implemented by payment processors like Stripe, which prioritize countries with more significant economic influence. By shifting your focus to a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can break free from these restrictions and establish a robust, independent infrastructure that allows you to reach a global audience without intermediaries.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A sovereign digital commerce stack involves a combination of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly to enable instant product delivery, automatic crypto payment processing, and full data ownership. At the core of this architecture are GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, all connected through a secure and scalable network.
Who This Is Built For and Why

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
